body_markdown:
###### Meet Rainbow’s Onchain Browser


Onchain Browser is the best mobile experience for exploring and transacting onchain. It’s a big step in the evolution of Rainbow and one of many important upgrades coming this month.


The Onchain Browser makes Rainbow **faster** , **smoother** , **safer** and more **reliable** .


Try it and earn extra points for interacting with dapps on the Onchain Browser. You’ll never want (or have) to leave Rainbow again


###### Connect to dapps like never before on mobile.


The Onchain Browser enables easy one-click wallet connection and keeps you signed in as long as you want — say goodbye to bouncing back and forth to Safari to connect and sign transactions. It also has anti-scam protection built in with[@blockaid_](https://x.com/blockaid_) transaction simulator so you can explore and connect to dapps without fear


###### Switch between Wallets with ease


###### Navigate multiple chains seamlessly


###### Explore the hottest dapps on Rainbow’s trending list, updated every day.


###### Customize your browser by pinning your favorite dapps.


###### Trade with confidence and speed.


Aping into coins with Rainbow is easier than ever with swaps and bridging easily accessible in the Onchain Browser + transaction simulation to keep you safe.
